method: Pure-Python glTF 2.0 / GLB parser (JSON chunk, bufferViews, accessors). World AABB from every referenced vertex transformed by full node hierarchy (exact, tighter than accessor-box AABB). Triangle counts from index buffers (mode 4). Zero-area threshold 1e-10 m^2. SHA-256 recomputed for every runtime file; Poly Haven runtime copies also checked against provider MD5 from the API file listing. Godot was NOT run; no asset modified.
limitations: Headless parsing does not prove visual correctness, shading, snapping in an assembled scene, collision behaviour, or navigation.
Visual evidence = existing 512 px Godot previews and the Blender contact sheet, viewed once each; no new renders were made.
Scale expectations are real-world reference ranges chosen by Agent 03, not art-direction requirements.

Cross-check: AABB sizes match coordinator godot_validation.json bounds within 2 mm for 66/68 assets; the two differences (stairs, radio transceiver) are because Godot reports transformed local boxes for rotated nodes.
